Robot control: measured motion and planning cost

Six predictors control the same simulated two-joint robot tasks. This replays 480 saved episodes, with ten paired tasks in each condition. The new affine-flow method couples motion and torque response. One development training seed establishes a pilot comparison; see the accompanying report for independent confirmation and its scope.

All controllers receive observations and replan every 40 ms. Coarse queries split at 10 ms command boundaries when commands update faster. Dashed red arms show the target. Playback follows physical motion time; the planning-time metric measures CPU work performed between observations.
